name: Coastal Paradise RV Resort
description: Coastal Paradise RV Resort has relaxing and scenic vistas that offers relaxation and nature at its best. If you need to escape to the outdoors while visiting the Alabama Gulf Coast, this is the resort for you. Park your RV in one of our spacious lots that are perfect for watching the sunset and spending time with family and friends–creating memories with your family and friends that will last a lifetime. Coastal Paradise RV Resort offers 13+ acres of wide-open country living with beautiful sunsets and we are located in Foley Alabama, and near Gulf Shores Alabama, Orange Beach Alabama and Mobile Alabama. We are located only 10 minutes to the Gulf Shores beaches. Enjoy the local sites like Owa Tropic Falls Amusement and Water Park, Tanger Outlet mall, numerous restaurants all while avoiding the heavy traffic and crowds. You can find us easily just off of Hwy 59 on Baldwin County Rd 65. Large and modern RV Sites with spacious back-in RV sites, concrete pads, full hookups (20/30/50-amp power, and water/sewer), on-site laundry facility, and safe and secure resort with on-site management and security. Looking to stay for the season? Yes, we offer monthly rentals on our back-in concrete pads. Spend your days exploring the local area and the Alabama Gulf Coast beaches. We believe that Coastal Paradise RV Resort is the perfect home base to experience it all.
